tldr: For a fixed finite cohort randomized with exactly half treatment, the worst simultaneous HT error is governed by complementary balanced masks crossing a monotone fractional path. The proposed second-layer capacity theorem gives \(F_N(m-2+e)\) order \(N\min\{N,1+\log_2(1/e)\}\), with explicit rational edge-star witnesses and a deterministic cover valid for every legal path. The strict right limit yields conservative simultaneous bands at the original HT center. Exact capacities and their chronological optimizer geometry remain an open question. The result is a specialist structural benchmark for extremely rare tails.
